# PantryPal Product Package

PRD status: APPROVED  
Screen specification status: APPROVED  
Visual reference status: MISSING

## Product

PantryPal is a responsive web application that helps households track pantry items and create a shopping list.

## Approved screens

- `SCR-001` Pantry overview
- `SCR-002` Add item sheet
- `SCR-003` Item detail
- `SCR-004` Shopping list
- `SCR-005` Empty pantry

## Approved behavior

- `ACT-001` Add item opens `SCR-002`.
- `ACT-002` Saving a valid item closes the sheet and updates `SCR-001`.
- `ACT-003` Selecting an item opens `SCR-003`.
- `ACT-004` Add to shopping list updates `SCR-004` and shows inline confirmation.

## Approved platform

- Mobile web: 390 px reference viewport
- Desktop web: 1440 px reference viewport
